lines.text: So... what did we decide last week?
Ever been in a meeting where nobody remembers the last meeting?
And the only record is, "follow up," with three question marks... next to a cat.
So give your meetings a memory.
Lynk records every meeting, online or in person, and keeps track of who said what, what was decided, and what's still open.
Then just ask. It answers from your own notes, and plays the exact moment it was said.
Sorry, my Wi-Fi died. What did I miss?
Nothing, Mark. The summary's already in your inbox.
Lynk. Your meetings finally have a memory. Start free at Lynk dot A I.

note: Lynkk is spelled 'Lynk' and lynkk.ai as 'Lynk dot A I' in the voice lines only, so the voice says it right. m1 is the manager, k1 is Mark.
